items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you think it's a good idea to name who was in that band? You and Bar faldi.

ctx.x: Yeah - I'd get it back together -- get it going again, but I went out to St. Louis and played the 400 Club and then I got an offer from there to go to anotherplace; so, when I got back to Chicago--- to New York, and I checked in the Downtown Hotel because I had sold my house in New Jersey; I didn't really have a place to live - it's a funny thing how this happened - I checked into this hotel; it was on Broadway -- I can't remember the name of the hotel -- just to check in and I got up to my room and the phone…
Do you think it's a good idea to name who was in that band? You and Bar faldi.
Oh, I don't remember; I had so many changes.
